name: amazon-scraper
description: Amazon product scraper with Node.js + Express backend and Vite frontend

scripts.install-all: npm run install-server && npm run install-client
scripts.test-api: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:' + (process.env.PORT || 3000) + '/api/health').then(async response => { if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status); console.log(await response.text()); }).catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('public/assets', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('public/index.html', { force: true });"

author: Natan Da Luz
